newsitem.title: USA: Most U.S. stock index futures rally, end higher.
newsitem.headline: Most U.S. stock index futures rally, end higher.

text.p: Aug 18 - Most U.S. stock index futures rallied in the afternoon and ended higher, with Sept S&P 500s up sharply. Traders call action a reversal from Friday's steep sell-off, say Friday move overdone. But overall Sept volume on Monday rally seen at 63,000 contracts, off from 69,000 traded on Friday's sell-off. Jitters expected heading into FOMC Tuesday.
